workflow.title: Route new website leads and log who got each lead
workflow.goal: Read new website leads. Every new lead in California goes to Marcus. Every new lead outside California goes to Priya, whatever its size. A California lead with more than 200 employees also goes to Priya. Append one lead-log row per assignment that names the lead and the assignee, then verify the rows.

assumptions: 'send to' means record the assignment in lead-log; no outbound e-mail or chat is sent.
California is identified by region equal to 'California' or 'CA' (case-insensitive).
Only leads with status 'new' are routed.
A California lead over 200 employees gets two log rows: one for Marcus and one for Priya.
risks: Region values spelled differently (e.g. 'Calif.') will not match and will go to Priya.
A lead with a missing companySize is still routed; it is never counted as over 200.
successCriteria: Every new lead is logged to lead-log for the correct assignee, naming the lead and the assignee.
The lead-log rows written by this run pass the independent sheet audit for each assignee.

Append Priya assignments (California over 200 employees) to lead-log.
